selection_policy: Explicit reference candidates, not latest-version claims. Resolve image tags/digests and compatibility in Phase 2; record updates before deployment.

metabase.note: Validate exact release image tag and immutable digest at pull time; release-page aliases are not deployment locks.

docker_compose.policy: Version 2 CLI; newer host version allowed after config/smoke tests.

phase2_required_checks: Resolve all container tags and lock platform-specific immutable digests.
Build Airflow providers and Python database/Kafka/JSON dependencies against matching constraints; freeze exact dependency versions.
Smoke-test metadata migrations, API authentication, LocalExecutor task execution and database connectivity.
Apply source, ops, ingestion and warehouse draft DDL in isolated databases and inspect constraints.
Verify Kafka internal/external listeners, retention, durable restart and consumer offset recovery.
Verify Metabase application PostgreSQL connection and SELECT-only reporting permissions.
Measure actual RAM/CPU/disk and adjust local resource settings.
